source.name: NSN Cycling Team, 'NSN and Stoneweg launch the NSN Cycling Team'
source.quote: the new WorldTour Team name is NSN Cycling Team, and the Conti Team name is NSN Development Team
source.note: Title sponsor and team co-owner; the NSN logo fills the chest and the upper back of the 2026 jersey (kit-reveal gallery, 9 Dec 2025: https://nsncyclingteam.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/CAuldPhoto-2025-NSN-Camp-Day2-1377-533x800.jpg, https://nsncyclingteam.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/CAuldPhoto-2025-NSN-Camp-Day1-9177-533x800.jpg).

source.name: NSN Cycling Team, 'NSN and Stoneweg launch the NSN Cycling Team'
source.quote: NSN (Never Say Never) and Stoneweg, a global investment platform based in Geneva, Switzerland, have entered into a joint venture in professional road cycling
source.note: Team co-owner; STONEWEG sits under the NSN logo on the front and the SW / STONEWEG mark on both sleeve cuffs (kit-reveal gallery, 9 Dec 2025: https://nsncyclingteam.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/CAuldPhoto-2025-NSN-Camp-Day2-1377-533x800.jpg).

source.name: NSN Cycling Team, 'Gallery: NSN Cycling Team reveals stunning 2026 jersey'
source.quote: Introducing our 2026 jersey, inspired by NSN’s home city of Barcelona.
source.note: The front photo (https://nsncyclingteam.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/CAuldPhoto-2025-NSN-Camp-Day2-1377-533x800.jpg) shows 'CANTINA FANTINI' on the lower front of the jersey and on the shorts. Listed as 'Cantini Fantini' under 'Our Partners' on the team's About page.

source.name: NSN Cycling Team, 'Gallery: NSN Cycling Team reveals stunning 2026 jersey'
source.quote: Introducing our 2026 jersey, inspired by NSN’s home city of Barcelona.
source.note: The front and side photos (https://nsncyclingteam.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/CAuldPhoto-2025-NSN-Camp-Day2-1377-533x800.jpg, https://nsncyclingteam.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/CAuldPhoto-2025-NSN-Camp-Day2-7339-533x800.jpg) show 'BRAINVEST Wealth Management' along the left shoulder. Listed under 'Our Partners' on the team's About page.

source.name: NSN Cycling Team, 'Gallery: NSN Cycling Team reveals stunning 2026 jersey'
source.quote: Introducing our 2026 jersey, inspired by NSN’s home city of Barcelona.
source.note: The front photo (https://nsncyclingteam.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/CAuldPhoto-2025-NSN-Camp-Day2-1377-533x800.jpg) shows 'PEACE PARK CAPITAL' running down the right sleeve. Listed under 'Our Partners' on the team's About page.

source.name: NSN Cycling Team, 'Gallery: NSN Cycling Team reveals stunning 2026 jersey'
source.quote: Introducing our 2026 jersey, inspired by NSN’s home city of Barcelona.
source.note: The rear photo (https://nsncyclingteam.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/CAuldPhoto-2025-NSN-Camp-Day1-9177-533x800.jpg) shows 'SCOTT' running down the rear side panels. SCOTT is the team's bike supplier from 2026 (team announcement, 3 Dec 2025: 'SCOTT and NSN Cycling Team today announce a multi-year sponsorship deal.').

source.name: NSN Cycling Team, 'Gallery: NSN Cycling Team reveals stunning 2026 jersey'
source.quote: Our jersey was designed by Stijn Dossche of stycle.design and produced by Ekoï.
source.note: Kit manufacturer (its logo also appears on the jersey chest/back, helmets and shorts); listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers.

summary: NSN and Stoneweg (the team's joint-venture owners) on the front, Cantina Fantini lower front and on the shorts, Peace Park Capital and Brainvest on the sleeve and shoulder, SCOTT on the rear side panels, kit made by Ekoï: read from the photos in the team's kit-reveal gallery (9 December 2025), which show no other commercial marks.
